title: My twin-stick roguelite Devil's Dungeon has a free browser beta, would love your feedback
author: Lazy_Assistance_1137
selftext:
Hey,

I've been building a iso top-down roguelite called Devil's Dungeon and I finally have something other people can play. It's a twin-stick shooter where you fight your way through three floors of hell, one room at a time, and pick up ability cards along the way.

You can play the beta right in your browser (PC). It's free and you don't need an account:

[https://abissele.itch.io/devils-dungeon](https://abissele.itch.io/devils-dungeon)

A few honest notes before you click.

This is a beta. The actual game is the PC version, and that one goes into Early Access on Steam in about a month.

I put the beta in the browser because that's the easiest way for anyone to just try it. The browser version isn't 100% fine-tuned yet though. The first load is around 120 MB and it can stutter in bigger rooms.

There's no tutorial. The game is pretty simple and you'll figure out most of it by trying things. 

Short version of the controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim and shoot, Shift to dash, Space to jump, E to interact, 1 to 4 for abilities.

You won't see everything in your first run. New enemies and abilities unlock as you keep playing.

Balancing is still very much in progress and there will be more versions before the Early Access launch. Sound is the biggest problem right now and I know it. That's going to get a lot more work.

It plays best on a desktop PC with keyboard and mouse. The text is available in English, German, Spanish and French, the voices are English only.

If you try it, I'd really like to know how the movement and shooting feel, which abilities seemed way too strong or just useless, and where it lagged or broke for you.

Thanks for giving it a shot!
